name: HPDP ticket
description: Take an HPDP Overlay task from intake to a PR in review.
on_start:
HPDP Overlay task: {input}
Follow the hpdp-overlay workflow: intake (read it, monitor it, and when a change is needed assign the ticket and move it to In Progress), a worktree for the ticket, tests first, local checks, a live check at 390, 1024 and 1440 px for user-visible changes, then the PR with the repository gates, the #hpdp-engineering post, and the Jira move to In Review. Chauffeur checks after each turn and keeps you going until the PR is open and in review. If the ticket, merchant, reference, worktree or live result is ambiguous, stop and ask.
on_budget:
HPDP task budget reached: {input}
Stop substantive work. Summarise what is done and verified, what remains before the PR can be in review, and what blocks it.
otherwise:
HPDP task: {input}
Not in review yet. Take the next step in the hpdp-overlay workflow: finish the change and its tests, check user-visible behaviour live at 390, 1024 and 1440 px, open the PR with the repository gates, post it in #hpdp-engineering, and move the covered tickets to In Review. If you are blocked on something only the user can provide, stop and say what you need.

steps.question: The HPDP Overlay task is: {input}. Judging from the agent's report, is its part finished: a PR is open, the covered Jira tickets are In Review, and nothing is left that the agent can do itself, so what remains is only other people's reviews, CI runs or merges? Also answer yes when the agent verified that no repository change is needed and reported that. Answer no when the agent still has work of its own, such as failing checks to fix, a PR to open, tickets to move, or the #hpdp-engineering post to make.

The HPDP Overlay task is: {input}. Did the agent stop because it needs something only the user can provide: an approval such as a browser connection, access, credentials, or a decision because the ticket, merchant, reference, worktree or live result is ambiguous, and say what it needs?

then.text:
HPDP task paused until you answer the agent: {input}
Resume it with /ticket resume.

steps.question: Did this HPDP Overlay task change user-visible behaviour of the overlay? Answer no for non-visual changes or when the user explicitly declined live checks.
Is live verification still missing for the changed behaviour? Answer no if the overlay has already been exercised at mobile, tablet and desktop widths, or a real blocker was reported.

then.text: Check the changed HPDP overlay behaviour live at 390px, 1024px and 1440px. Confirm #am-overlay is mounted; compare the result with the task reference and report any blocker.

steps.question: The HPDP Overlay task is: {input}. Are its required tests, diff review and any user-visible live checks complete, with no PR open yet and no user instruction against one? Answer no when checks remain, a blocker is unresolved, or a PR already exists.

then.text: The HPDP Overlay work is ready for review. Follow the repository PR workflow and gates, then commit, push and open the PR for this task, post it in #hpdp-engineering, and move the covered tickets to In Review.
